page.notes: The marginal note "a Ep.2.c. 6. T. 3. Conc. Gall. p. 73." is set in small type in the right margin, beside the lines "epistola a" through "tanniæ"; the mark "a" in the text is taken to refer to it. Some words are uncertain in the scan, notably "Ze-" (catchword) and the italic "utebantur", which is read as printed. The text on the right margin at the top of the page is blurred by scanning artefacts and not transcribed.
